name: jsoncpp
input_api: Json::CharReaderBuilder::newCharReader()->parse(const char* begin, const char* end, Json::Value*, std::string*) with CharReaderBuilder::strictMode
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text (strict mode: no comments, object/array root, no trailing data) parsed into a Json::Value tree
family_note: Own recursive-descent reader in src/lib_json/json_reader.cpp (OurReader behind CharReaderBuilder); no delegation to another JSON parser.

name: simdjson
license_evidence: LICENSE and LICENSE-MIT in pinned v5.0.4 source archive
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text parsed from a local pointer and byte length into a simdjson DOM element; observed valid control subset
family_note: Pinned v5.0.4 singleheader amalgamation contains simdjson own structural scan and DOM parser. The ARM64 Docker build runs the native ARM64 implementation; it does not delegate to JsonCpp or nlohmann/json. The pointer-and-length overload pads a temporary copy as documented.

name: nlohmann-json
input_api: nlohmann::json::parse(IteratorType first, IteratorType last, parser_callback_t cb = nullptr, bool allow_exceptions = true, bool ignore_comments = false) called on the byte range with allow_exceptions=false and ignore_comments=false
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text (comments rejected, object/array root, no trailing data) parsed into a nlohmann::json value
family_note: Header-only lexer (include/nlohmann/detail/input/lexer.hpp) and recursive-descent parser (detail/input/parser.hpp) with SAX DOM builder; no shared code with JsonCpp OurReader and no delegation to another JSON parser.

name: RapidJSON
input_api: rapidjson::Document::Parse(const char* json, size_t length) over locally supplied bytes; default strict parse flags
scope: RFC 8259-compatible JSON text through length-bounded DOM Parse; object/array roots on two valid controls
family_note: Own header-only GenericReader and GenericDocument implementation; no JsonCpp, simdjson or nlohmann/json parser dependency. Only include/rapidjson headers are compiled; the archive also contains third-party examples/tests with separate license terms.

name: Boost.JSON
input_api: boost::json::parse(string_view s, boost::system::error_code& ec, storage_ptr sp = {}, parse_options const& opt = {}) over locally supplied bytes; default options accept only standard JSON
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text through one-step parse(string_view, error_code&) with default strict options; object/array roots on two valid controls
family_note: Own header-only basic_parser (boost/json/basic_parser_impl.hpp) feeding value_stack into boost::json::value; independent of JsonCpp, simdjson, nlohmann/json and RapidJSON. Built header-only from the official Boost 1.92.0 archive via boost/json/src.hpp; the other Boost headers it includes are compiled but not counted as parser source.
